results.title: Novo wants to change how Wall Street owns its stock: why now
results.description: Novo Nordisk wants a bigger presence on Wall Street, and the timing may say more about the drugmaker’s challenges than the listing itself. Chief executive Mike Doustdar said Novo could see advantages in replacing its American depositary receipts with shares listed directly in New York. But the idea comes days after investors punished Novo’s latest growth strategy, with competition from Eli Lilly intensifying and questions mounting over what eventually replaces Ozempic and Wegovy. Novo already depends heavily on America Novo currently gives US investors access through ADRs traded on the New York Stock Exchange, while its primary shares are listed in Copenhagen.
